# Coforma Studio

Compact LLM context index for this repository.

## Read first

- `AGENTS.md` — canonical agent operating instructions.
- `README.md` — human/product overview when present.
- `ECOSYSTEM.md` — MADFAM ecosystem and Enclii deployment context when present.
- `llms-full.txt` — full context map and durable operating contract.

## Production operations

Routine production operations are Enclii-first. Use Enclii web, API, or CLI
before raw infrastructure tools. Direct `kubectl`, `helm`, SSH, provider CLIs,
`docker exec`, or direct container access is bootstrap/break-glass only.

## What this repo is

Coforma Studio: Customer Advisory Boards as a service. pnpm/turbo monorepo:
`packages/web` (Next.js 15.5 App Router, tRPC 10.45), `packages/api` (NestJS +
Prisma, Postgres with row-level security), `packages/types`, `packages/ui`,
`packages/client`.

## Key docs

- `AGENTS.md` "Current state" — stack, deploy, CI gates, known gaps, backlog, related repositories and contracts.
- `PROJECT_STATUS.md` — authoritative status.
- `docs/deployment.md` — current deploy path at the top; the Vercel/Railway material below it is historical.
- `docs/deploy-readiness.md` — why only the web shell ships.

## Facts that are easy to get wrong

- Only the web image deploys (in-repo `build-deploy.yml` → GHCR → cosign → digest pin → Argo CD). The API is not deployed. Vercel and Railway are not used.
- CI jobs are pinned to `ubuntu-24.04`, not `ubuntu-latest`.
- `@coforma/web` ESLint (#113) and `pnpm format:check` (#114) are advisory in CI.
- Identity is Janua; billing is meant to be Dhanam but is not integrated; Stripe mentions are historical.
